notes: The marginal note 'Or, travail' at ʿinyān was read and set aside (rule 38).
'and if' was read as one rendering of the waw under rule 55's contiguity test rather than as a surplus subordinator, headed on the coordinator.
hahûʾ takes the phrase's single determiner 'those' and both articles are unrepresented, exactly as rule 41 reads `הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא` → *that place*.
ʾên and məʾûmâ share the single word 'nothing', which carries both senses, with the presentative frame joining the unit (rules 35, 50).
